input.command:
Set-Location "C:\Users\maury\Documents\Murf Challenge\frontend"
$base = "http://localhost:3001"
try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$base/dashboard" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 90; Write-Output "/dashboard $($r.StatusCode)" } catch { Write-Output "/dashboard ERR $($_.Exception.Message)" }

Write-Output "`n=== GET /api/catalogue (summary) ==="
$cat = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/api/catalogue" -TimeoutSec 30
Write-Output "items=$($cat.catalogue.Count) categories=$($cat.categories.Count) total=$($cat.total) db.connected=$($cat.db.connected) records=$($cat.db.records)"
Write-Output "sample: $($cat.catalogue[0].name) | $($cat.catalogue[0].category) | Rs$($cat.catalogue[0].unit_price) | stock=$($cat.catalogue[0].stock_qty)"

Write-Output "`n=== POST /api/catalogue order-total quote ==="
$item = $cat.catalogue[0].name
$body = @{ items = @(@{ name = $item; quantity = 3 }) } | ConvertTo-Json
$q = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/api/catalogue" -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json' -TimeoutSec 30
Write-Output "quote for 3x $item -> total=$($q.total) lines=$($q.line_items.Count) issues=$($q.issues.Count)"
$q | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5

input.command:
$base = "http://localhost:3001"
# Hand-built JSON so `items` is guaranteed an array; correct key = item_name
$json = '{"items":[{"item_name":"milk","quantity":3},{"item_name":"rice","quantity":2},{"item_name":"unobtainium","quantity":1}]}'
$q = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/api/catalogue" -Method Post -Body $json -ContentType 'application/json' -TimeoutSec 30
Write-Output "total=$($q.total)  lines=$($q.line_items.Count)  issues=$($q.issues.Count)"
foreach ($li in $q.line_items) { Write-Output ("  {0} x{1} @ Rs{2} = Rs{3}" -f $li.name, $li.quantity, $li.unit_price, $li.line_total) }
foreach ($is in $q.issues) { Write-Output "  ISSUE: $is" }
input.description: POST order-total with correct item_name key + issues case
